title: Path hits a target
statement: For a regular multigraph $G$, target vertex $t$, starting vertex $v$, and a list of edge slots, define whether the corresponding walk hits $t$ as follows: it does if $v=t$, or if, after following the first listed slot from $v$, the walk specified by the remaining slots hits $t$. The empty list hits $t$ exactly when $v=t$.
